decisions.actualScientificAssessment: Actual image shows four duplicated X-shaped chromosomes marked A/B/C/D before division. Each daughter receives exactly one single-chromatid rod of each same colour/letter A/B/C/D. The whole set is preserved in both daughters, with neither homolog selection nor random partial allocation. Kopien bereit places duplication before the displayed division. This is a chromosome-level identity model, not a claim that mitosis itself synthesises DNA or reduces chromosome number.

decisions.actualScientificAssessment: Actual image shows same flower/leaf type across two parent plants and five offspring varying in height. Offspring include both shorter and taller examples; no uniform directed improvement, survival selection or species replacement is displayed. Parents→offspring arrow marks generation sequence; Keine feste Richtung denies an evolutionary destination. It is an illustration of observable within-species variation, not evidence of a heritability estimate or a molecular cause.

decisions.actualScientificAssessment: Actual image highlights a chromosome section as Gen, then a separate abstract enzyme-like Genprodukt receives yellow particles and yields orange particles, then points to a green leaf as Merkmal. This represents an example contribution through a gene product rather than a gene acting as a leaf. It omits DNA chemistry, transcription/translation and base sequences, consistent with the source’s explicit nonmolecular model. Vereinfachtes Beispiel limits the example; it is not a universal one-gene/one-trait or environment-free causal law.
